caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object with a rusted, brownish surface featuring signs of age and wear. The object has two distinct protrusions: the left protrusion is long, straight, and tapers to a point, while the right protrusion arches in a smooth curve, ending in a hook-like tip. Both are attached to a cylindrical base that appears to be partially split and wraps around itself at the bottom, exposing part of the interior. A small, round white element is visible near the base opening. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or patterns present. The artist’s signature and date “Oscar Droege 1929” appears at the lower right corner.
title: Bent Raider or Pike
